arxiv-2412-20649.title: Chaos synchronization: a review
arxiv-2412-20649.creator: Rosário D. Laureano, Diana A. Mendes, Manuel Alberto M. Ferreira
arxiv-2412-20649.description: Abstract ABSTRACT: This article provides a self-contained comprehensive review of the phenomenon of synchronization in dynamical systems, with a particular focus on chaotic systems in both continuous-time and discrete-time contexts. Synchronization, initially observed by Christiaan Huygens in 1665, has evolved from the study of periodic signals to encompass chaotic systems, where the sensitive dependence on initial conditions poses unique challenges.

pmc-10623728.title: Herbal medicine formula Huazhuo Tiaozhi granule ameliorates dyslipidaemia via regulating histone lactylation and miR-155-5p biogenesis
pmc-10623728.creator: Xiangjun Yin, Min Li, Yongzhi Wang, Guifang Zhao, Tao Yang, Yuqing Zhang, Jianbo Guo, Tiantian Meng, Ruolin Du, Honglin Li, Zhe Wang, Jian Zhang, Qingyong He
pmc-10623728.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundHuazhuo Tiaozhi granule (HTG) is a herbal medicine formula widely used in clinical practice for hypolipidaemic effects. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying dyslipidaemia treatment have not been well elucidated.ResultsA significant reduction in the levels of total cholesterol (TC) and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) was observed in the serum of patients with dyslipidaemia after HTG treatment, without disruption in the levels of aspartate transaminase (AST), alanine transaminase (ALT), urea nitrogen (BUN), and creatinine (Cr).

pmc-10670311.description: The purpose of this study was to investigate the effect of Tremella fuciformis polysaccharides on the physicochemical properties of freeze–thawed cone chestnut starch. Various aspects, including water content, crystallinity, particle size, gelatinization, retrogradation, thermal properties, rheological properties, and texture, were examined.

pmc-11516683.title: Analyzing Public Discourse on the Affordable Care Act through YouTube Comments
pmc-11516683.creator: T McKelvy, J Garman, K Green, J Mongeaux, L Ivanitskaya, R Bizri-Baryak
pmc-11516683.description: IntroductionSocial media’s pervasive role in daily life provides a unique avenue for understanding public sentiments. This study utilizes YouTube comments on an MSNBC video about the Affordable Care Act (ACA) to explore public opinions on the policy and its political implications.MethodsA qualitative analysis of YouTube comments on an MSNBC video was conducted. Netlytic, a scraping tool, gathered 1,949 comments.

pmc-11571648.title: Amplifying youth voices: young people’s recommendations for policy and practice to enhance vaccine acceptability
pmc-11571648.creator: Oluwaseyi Dolapo Somefun, Marisa Casale, Genevieve Haupt Ronnie, Joshua Sumankuuro, Olagoke Akintola, Chris Desmond, Lucie Cluver
pmc-11571648.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic has underscored the need for increased vaccine availability and uptake, with vaccine hesitancy posing a significant barrier, particularly among young adults. Evidence from various countries highlight high levels of hesitancy among young people, necessitating targeted interventions. Engaging young adults as key stakeholders in shaping public health strategies is crucial, as their perspectives can enhance vaccine acceptance.

pmc-13395655.title: Fu’s subcutaneous needling: a traditional acupuncture radiating new therapeutic potentials
pmc-13395655.creator: Jinfeng Zhang, Xin Liu, Yan Lu, Binghui Li, Yunjie Cai, Jinlian Liu, Xiaoyong Sun
pmc-13395655.description: BackgroundFu’s subcutaneous needling (FSN) is a brainchild of conventional acupuncture and modern medicine. pmc-13505014.title: Ferroptosis as an immunometabolic checkpoint in brain tumours: spatial vulnerabilities and therapeutic opportunities
pmc-13505014.creator: Maher Nassor, Saim Chaudhry, Fahmida Zahin, Subham Roy, Kay Paulina K Odei, Princess Afia Nkrumah-Boateng, Andrew Awuah Wireko
pmc-13505014.description: Brain tumours, particularly glioblastoma, remain among the most lethal cancers due to considerable spatial variation, metabolic adaptability, immune suppression, and resistance to standard therapies. Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of regulated cell death driven by lipid peroxidation, presents a candidate target for new treatments in these tumours.
